paragraphs: R' Ada, son of R' Shimon, [Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, chapter 1, halakhah 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Megillah.1.9.8).
[Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 2, at the end of halakhah 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.2.3.18), reads R' Idi, son of R' Shimon.
R' Yehudah, son of R' Shimon, [Chullin 48a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.48a.15).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The parallel Yerushalmi passages have Ada bar Shimon and Idi bar Rabbi Shimon, respectively, transmitting the same prayer ruling in Rabbi Yochanan’s name.
Chullin names Rabbi Yehudah be-Rabbi Shimon separately. Hyman collects the patronymics under Shimon.
